items.title: Oil Holds Gains, Yen in Focus After Weakening: Markets Wrap
items.content: Oil held onto gains as fading hopes for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz revived inflation concerns before key US data this week.
items.summary: Oil holds gains as fading Strait of Hormuz deal hopes stoke inflation concerns ahead of US data.

items.title: Traders Are Piling Into Taiwan Dollar Options to Bet on Rebound
items.content: Currency traders are stepping up bullish options bets on the Taiwan dollar, signaling a shift in sentiment after the currency suffered its worst July since 2015.
items.summary: Currency traders are increasing bullish bets on the Taiwan dollar via options after a poor July, signaling a potential rebound.
